messages.content: Quick question. What laptop should I get for programming?
For programming, a laptop with 16GB+ RAM and an SSD matters most. A MacBook Air, a ThinkPad, or a Dell XPS are all reasonable depending on your budget and OS preference.

What laptop should I get for programming?
For programming, a laptop with 16GB+ RAM and an SSD matters most. A MacBook Air, a ThinkPad, or a Dell XPS are all reasonable depending on your budget and OS preference.
Which code editor should a beginner use?
VS Code is the most beginner-friendly with a huge extension ecosystem. If you want something lighter, try Sublime Text; if you prefer the terminal, Neovim has a steeper curve.
Quick question. What backup solution should I use for my laptop?
Follow 3-2-1: Time Machine or an external drive for local, plus a cloud backup like Backblaze or restic to object storage. Test a restore once so you know it works.
Which CI service is best for an open-source repo?
GitHub Actions is the default for repos already on GitHub and is free for public projects. GitLab CI and CircleCI are also solid if you need their specific features.
What monitoring tool should I set up for my servers?
Prometheus with Grafana is the common open-source stack. For a hosted option, Datadog or Grafana Cloud reduce setup. Start with basic CPU, memory, and error-rate alerts.
Quick question. What's a solid note-taking app?
Obsidian is great for local Markdown notes, Notion for structured docs and databases, and Apple Notes if you just want something built-in and fast.
